message.text: Locating the outbound webhook delivery function and its SSRF protection mechanism.
I'll look up outbound webhook delivery and any SSRF / internal-address guards around it.
Found the webhook package. Now examining its files and httpgetter for SSRF protection.

I am locating the outbound HTTP notification delivery function and its protection against internal network addresses.

Delivery executes in `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go`; `PostAsync` queues to workers that call it. `safeDialContext` in that same file blocks dialing to reserved or private IPs at connection time. `ValidateURL` in `internal/webhook/validate.go` rejects webhook URLs that resolve to private IPs via `isReservedIP` and `reservedCIDRs`.

h02.
`Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`; `safeDialContext` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`

Outbound webhook HTTP POSTs run in `Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`), which is what the async workers call. Delivery uses `safeClient`, whose `DialContext` is `safeDialContext`: it resolves the host and refuses reserved/private ranges (`isReservedIP` / `reservedCIDRs` in `internal/webhook/validate.go`), so the target cannot be an internal address (including DNS rebinding). `ValidateURL` in the same file applies the same check when a webhook URL is configured.
